## Description

Superseded scope (ADR-016): Medvya reviews organisations, not doctors. Runbook for reviewing an onboarding request: which documents per type (Clinic, Hospital), what is checked against which public register or certificate, evidence recorded, SLA (target one working day, to be confirmed), standard reasons for ask-for-changes and reject, suspension and re-approval, and who may decide. Doctor licences are attested by the owner and are not checked here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Runbook published in docs/runbooks/organisation-onboarding-review.md and linked from the platform console queue (MDV-P5-044).
- [ ] **AC2.** Every pilot organisation is approved with recorded evidence of what was checked before it registers patients.
- [ ] **AC3.** The runbook states that Medvya does not verify individual doctors and where the owner's attestation is recorded.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
